itemdesc-weatherglass: A brass barometer. Right-click to read pressure, trend and forecast. Pressure falls before squalls.
itemdesc-windvane: Right-click to read the wind: direction, strength in knots and Beaufort force.
itemdesc-anchor: Right-click while riding a sailboat to drop or raise the anchor. Drags in gales.
itemdesc-logbook: Right-click to read your sailing record: distance, squalls and temporal storms survived.
itemdesc-compass: Right-click for a full sailing report: wind, sea state, point of sail, sail and hull condition. Spins in temporal storms.
itemdesc-riggingline: Right-click while riding a sailboat to cycle the sails: full, reefed, furled.
itemdesc-repairkit: Right-click near a sailboat to patch the worse of hull or sails (+25%). Wears out after 24 uses.
